description:
*****COMMUNAL TREES****
        FRONT LAWN / BEECH	
T1	Crack Willow (Salix fragilis)	Re-Pollard back to previous pollard points removing approximately 2m of new growth.
        Final height 3m and spread 2m.	

T2	Crack Willow (Salix fragilis)	Re-Pollard back to previous pollard points removing approximately 4-5m of new growth.
        Final height 3.5m and spread 3.5m.	

T3	Crack Willow (Salix fragilis)	Re-Pollard back to previous pollard points removing approximately 4-5m of new growth.
        Final height 4m and spread 3m.	

T4	Crack Willow (Salix fragilis)	Re-Pollard back to previous pollard points removing approximately 4-5m of new growth.
        Final height 4m and spread 3m.

	EVENS	

T5	Honey locust (Gleditsia triacanthos)	OPPOSITE No. 60/58 - Prune away from building to give at least 2m clearance


1	T6	Katsura (Cerciiphyllum japonicum)	OUTSIDE F&M BLOCK - Reduce back selected branches to provide 2m clearance from the balcony.
        Final height unchanged at 8m and spread 6m.	

G7	Tree Of Heaven (Alianthus altissima)	2 x DYING TREES BY EVENS GATE - Fell to ground level and remove all arisings. 

        MAIN DRIVE	

T8	Norway Maple (Acer platanoides)	OUTSIDE MAIN F&M ODDS BLOCK - Remove 4-5 growth poles, where coming close to corner of building.  	

T9	False Acacia (Robinia pseudoacacia)	OUTSIDE No. 12 - Reduce back selected branches to provide 2m clearance from No.12.
        Final height unchanged at 12m and spread 7m.	

1	T10	False Acacia (Robinia pseudoacacia)	OUTSIDE No. 18 - Reduce back selected branches to provide 2m clearance from No.18.
        Final height unchanged at 15m and spread 8m.


T11	False Acacia (Robinia pseudoacacia)	Outside No. 22 - Reduce away from gutter. 	

G12	Sweet Gum (Liquidambar styraciflua)	2 x TREES OPPOSITE No. 95 - Reduce back selected branches to provide 2m clearance from corner of building.  
        Final height unchanged at 12m and spread 6m.


G13	Honey locust (Gleditsia triacanthos)	3 x TREES OPPOSITE No. 89 - On the two larger trees - Reduce back selected branches to provide 2m clearance
        from building, and ensure on branches over sailing roof. Final height unchanged at 13m and spread 8m.
